about: V290 development cases. The fresh probe set (fresh_probe_sealed.json) was sealed first; its errors were grouped into error TYPES and, for each type, these new cases were written in different words, Arabic and English, together with mild look-alikes that must NOT be raised. V290 rules were built on these cases. Author-written, development set; starter labels, not clinician-verified.
